bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12” x 6” x 12” are allowed in the venue. All bags will be searched prior to entry, and non-clear bags will undergo additional search.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: There is no on-site parking at The Van Buren. They have partnered with ParkWhiz for parking options nearby. Limited metered street parking and nearby paid lots are available, but fill up quickly.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in The Van Buren's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Bars sell beverages inside The Van Buren. Outside food and drinks are prohibited; guests may generally bring up to two factory-sealed water bottles of no more than 32 ounces each.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Buy accessible tickets online at thevanburenphx.com; for reserved seating events, use the Show accessible tickets toggle. For general admission events, request accessible seating from the Box Office at 480.659.1641 or info@thevanburenphx.com, since the area is first-come, first-served. The main entrance is accessible, and the mezzanine balcony is reachable only by stairs.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not allowed. The Van Buren does not do in-and-outs, so don't leave unless you are done for the night.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The box office is on 4th Avenue and opens two hours before doors on show days, or at noon when the show falls on a Monday, Wednesday, or Friday. It is cashless. Reach it at (480) 659-1641 or info@thevanburenphx.com.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The main entrance is accessible. Guests with accessibility needs can skip the general admission line and check in at the main entrance security podium. The mezzanine balcony is reachable only by stairs.
